sourceEvidence: packages/contracts/src/localization/index.ts defines the closed locale/direction catalogs, strict LocalizedText schema, default fallback, and separate UI translation-key schema.
apps/api/src/modules/localization/content.ts resolves requested content with deterministic fallback and returns the actual locale and direction without fabricating content.
apps/api/tests/localization/content.test.ts covers all locales, RTL/LTR, strict unknown-field rejection, empty/control-character validation, custom/default fallback, and CMS/UI-key separation.
docs/api/localization.md documents partial draft content, deterministic fallback order, truthful absent states, and the boundary between CMS values and UI keys.

Necessary integration files outside the atomic Allowed Roots were limited to packages/contracts/src/contracts/index.ts for public contract exports and apps/api/src/modules/testing/test-suites.ts for focused-test registration. Neither change implements a future task.
knownGaps: The local runtime is Node 22.18.0 while the repository and CI declare Node 24; all local verification passed, but the hosted Node 24 quality run remains a CI readiness check.
This primitive intentionally does not backfill or fabricate production CMS translations; owning aggregates may remain Draft, absent, empty, or unavailable until approved content exists.
